chapter_title: Methods of Separation in Everyday Life

content.summary: 'Methods of Separation in Everyday Life' is organised around source-supported concepts, evidence and applications.
key_points: —कबीर  Just like winnowing makes the husk blow away while retaining the grains, similarly, sages let the virtues stay while discarding the vices.
—Kabir Malli and his sister Valli are excited for their summer vacations.
Their parents have planned a trip to visit their relatives and friends living across India.
They always stay in touch with their relatives and friends.
Their first halt is at their Nani’s (maternal grandmother’s) house in Haryana.
Malli and Valli are fascinated by the variety of grains piled up in the courtyard.
